correctness.rationale: The section type under translation-invariant unoriented affine-plane measure is obtained from ordered vertex projections: quadrilateral offsets are the middle gap. Integrating edge-crossing counts gives (3+p4) E(width)=sum(edge lengths)/2. The polyhedral exterior-dihedral mean width identity E(width)=sum(length*exterior_angle)/(4*pi) verifies the full tetrahedron normalization. In T_t the edge and facet normal dot products give L=sqrt(1+t²), alpha=2acos(t/sqrt(1+2t²)), beta=2acos(1/sqrt(1+2t²)). Differentiating F=(2L alpha+sqrt(2) beta)/(2L+sqrt(2)) cancels the angular derivative and gives F'=2 sqrt(2) t (alpha-beta)/(L(2L+sqrt(2))²). Its sign is sign(1-t); since p4=2pi/F-3 this proves unique global minimum t=1, strict monotonicity on both sides, and limit values sqrt(2)-1 and 1. The expansion coefficient pi sqrt(2)/(9 acos(-1/3)^2) follows by F''(1)=-sqrt(2)/9. Independently computed p4 using 30,000 deterministic spherical directions at seven t values: agreement to <=0.0031; numerical agreement does not establish infinite-t monotonicity.
residual_risks: Finite numerical checks establish only their finite instances; mathematical conclusions rest on analytical proof or complete finite enumeration as described.
